rationale: Adds MainThreadScope and MainThreadTimer to the generic platform layer: main-thread posting and millisecond timers on a CFRunLoopSource and CFRunLoopTimers in the common modes, which keep running during menu tracking, live resize and modal panels and leave no run-loop callback behind once the scope is destroyed. Additive, host-neutral and free of view or render dependencies, so the next Vellum re-export of core/platform should carry it.
